name: zimbabwe-vat
description: Zimbabwe VAT return work, tax year 2026: the 15.5% standard rate from 1 January 2026, registration at USD 25,000, VAT categories, returns on the 10th and payment on the 15th, fiscal tax invoices through FDMS, imported services paid in USD, digital services withholding tax, and 10% export taxes on some minerals. Use for classifying transactions, preparing a VAT return, or questions such as what is the VAT rate in Zimbabwe, do I need to register for VAT with ZIMRA, or can I claim input tax on this invoice.
